content_json.title: Start with college gift moments
content_json.what_it_means: Students buy gifts for birthdays, farewells, friends, couples, and small celebrations.
what_to_do: Create posts for each college gift moment.
Ask friends to share in student groups.
Offer pickup or local delivery near college areas.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can post: Farewell gift for your best friend in {{location}}? Send the name/photo and we will show a preview.
content_json.why_this_helps: Specific student moments are easier to remember than a general gift post.
content_json.how_to_check: Check which occasion gets the most replies and saves.

title: Use simple Malayalam-English when it fits

content_json.title: Use simple Malayalam-English when it fits
content_json.what_it_means: Local words can make the brand feel closer to students in Kerala.
what_to_do: Use simple mixed-language captions only when it sounds natural.
Keep the order details in clear English.
Test one local-style caption each week.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can say: Gift venam, but basic aakaruthu. Send your idea. We will show a preview before making.
content_json.why_this_helps: The post feels more local and less like a generic brand page.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if local-style captions get more replies or shares from students.
